methodology.flat: Single agent, direct solve, no explicit decomposition or revision phase
methodology.hierarchical: Plan decomposition into 2-5 subtasks, independent subtask execution, integration pass
methodology.debate: Two independent solver passes (Agent A, Agent B), comparison and resolution phase

dit_routing.note: DIT-based routing achieves 97.6% on 42 strongly-typed tasks vs best single topology (debate) at 65.9%

replication_stability.conclusion: Run 3 replicates Run 1 findings within expected variance. All topology orderings preserved. Maximum per-topology accuracy delta is 4.9pp, well within the 5pp stability threshold.

flat.variance_note: Flat agent produced clean ABC hierarchy for Source/Transformer/Sink. Previous run got lost in design phase.
